channel.title: CIS 141 – Privacy and Artificial Intelligence :: CS Two Year Refactor
channel.description: Course Description Philosophical definitions of privacy, metrics (differential privacy, information leakage) and modern privacy tools as they apply, or apply to, AI. Hands-on applications to structured (tabular) and unstructured (images, videos) data. Timely real-world privacy problems faced by, and caused by, AI.
